events.title: 53rd Bayou Classic: Southern vs. Grambling
events.addr: 1500 Sugar Bowl Dr, New Orleans, LA 70112
events.blurb: The 53rd edition of the historic HBCU rivalry game between Southern and Grambling, played Saturday afternoon in the Superdome.
events.blurbEs: La 53.ª edición del histórico clásico entre las universidades HBCU Southern y Grambling, el sábado por la tarde en el Superdome.

events.title: Bayou Classic Battle of the Bands & Greek Show
events.addr: 1500 Sugar Bowl Dr, New Orleans, LA 70112
events.blurb: Southern's Human Jukebox and Grambling's Tiger Marching Band face off on Friday night, followed by the Greek step show. Doors open at 5 p.m. at Gate C; clear-bag policy applies.
events.blurbEs: La Human Jukebox de Southern y la Tiger Marching Band de Grambling se enfrentan el viernes por la noche, seguidas del Greek Show de step. Las puertas abren a las 5 p.m. por la Gate C; se exigen bolsas transparentes.

events.title: Bayou Classic Fan Festival
events.venue: Champions Square at the Caesars Superdome
events.addr: 1500 Sugar Bowl Dr, New Orleans, LA 70112
events.blurb: A free, all-ages pregame fan festival on Saturday morning outside the Superdome before the Southern–Grambling game.
events.blurbEs: Un festival gratuito para todas las edades el sábado por la mañana afuera del Superdome, antes del partido Southern–Grambling.

events.title: Celebration in the Oaks
events.blurb: City Park's holiday light walk winds through the park's old oaks on its opening weekend. Walking tickets start at $20 on value nights, and children under 2 get in free.
events.blurbEs: El recorrido de luces navideñas de City Park serpentea entre sus robles centenarios en su fin de semana inaugural. Las entradas a pie empiezan en $20 en noches de tarifa reducida y los menores de 2 años entran gratis.

events.title: Deck the Stalls Black Friday Pop-Up Shops
events.blurb: A Black Friday afternoon of live horse racing with local pop-up shops at the Fair Grounds. Grandstand admission is free; doors open at 11:45 a.m. and the first race is at 12:55 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Una tarde de Black Friday con carreras de caballos en vivo y tiendas emergentes locales en el Fair Grounds. La entrada a la tribuna es gratis; las puertas abren a las 11:45 a.m. y la primera carrera es a las 12:55 p.m.

events.title: Ali Siddiq: The Custom Fit Tour
events.blurb: Stand-up comedian Ali Siddiq brings his Custom Fit Tour to the restored 1927 Saenger Theatre on Canal Street.
events.blurbEs: El comediante Ali Siddiq trae su Custom Fit Tour al restaurado Saenger Theatre de 1927 en Canal Street.

events.title: The Dirty Dozen Brass Band + The Zahria Sims Collective
events.blurb: The Dirty Dozen Brass Band plays the Uptown landmark Tipitina's on Saturday night, with The Zahria Sims Collective opening. Doors at 7:30 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La Dirty Dozen Brass Band toca el sábado por la noche en Tipitina's, el clásico club de Uptown, con The Zahria Sims Collective como teloneros. Puertas a las 7:30 p.m.

events.title: Preservation Hall Concerts
events.addr: 726 St Peter St, New Orleans, LA 70116
events.blurb: Short traditional jazz sets in the French Quarter's intimate Preservation Hall: the All-Stars featuring Shannon Powell on Saturday and featuring Andrew Baham on Sunday. Friday is sold out.
events.blurbEs: Sesiones cortas de jazz tradicional en el íntimo Preservation Hall del French Quarter: los All-Stars con Shannon Powell el sábado y con Andrew Baham el domingo. El viernes está agotado.
